py: nǐ mā ma yě zài jiā ma
en: Is your mom at home too?
why: 也 is in the sentence, so the question has to be marked with 吗 at the end. A-not-A (在不在) cannot follow 也, and 还是 needs two options to choose between.

py: nǐ men jiā yǒu méi yǒu xǐ yī jī
en: Does your family have a washing machine?
why: 有 is negated only by 没, so its A-not-A form is 有没有. 有不有 does not exist, and 吗 would pile a second question marker onto the sentence.

zh: 你想不想买这辆自行车？
py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng mǎi zhè liàng zì xíng chē
en: Do you want to buy this bike?
why: With a modal verb, double the modal: 想不想, then the plain verb 买 follows. 买不想 doubles in the wrong order, and 想吗 puts a 吗 in the middle of the sentence.

zh: 你昨天买没买那件外套？
py: nǐ zuó tiān mǎi méi mǎi nà jiàn wài tào
en: Did you buy that coat yesterday?
why: 昨天 puts the purchase in the past, and a past action is negated with 没, so the A-not-A form is 买没买. 买不买 asks about a habit or a decision still to be made.

zh: 你是不是也想买这条裙子？
py: nǐ shì bú shì yě xiǎng mǎi zhè tiáo qún zi
en: Do you want to buy this skirt too?
why: 是不是 can stand before a whole predicate to check a guess, so it can come before 也. 想不想 would repeat the modal in front of 想买, and 吗 can only close the sentence.

py: nǐ xǐ huan hóng de hái shì lán de
en: Do you like the red one or the blue one?
why: A question that offers two choices puts 还是 between them. 或者 is the plain "or" of statements, and 吗 cannot be added to a choice question.

q: 周末我想在家洗衣服___看电视。
zh: 周末我想在家洗衣服或者看电视。
py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng zài jiā xǐ yī fu huò zhě kàn diàn shì
en: At the weekend I want to wash clothes or watch TV at home.
why: This is a statement listing two possible plans, so "or" is 或者. 还是 is kept for questions that ask the listener to pick one.

zh: 你们是现金付款还是刷卡？
py: nǐ men shì xiàn jīn fù kuǎn hái shì shuā kǎ
en: Will you pay in cash or by card?
why: The shop assistant wants one of two answers, so 还是 goes between the options. 或者 belongs to statements, and no 吗 is needed.

q: 你要大号的___小号的，我去仓库给你拿。
zh: 你要大号的还是小号的，我去仓库给你拿。
py: nǐ yào dà hào de hái shì xiǎo hào de wǒ qù cāng kù gěi nǐ ná
en: Do you want the large size or the small size? I will fetch it from the storeroom.
why: Offering the customer a choice is 还是. 或者 would not ask for a decision, and 吗 or 也 cannot link two options.

py: shéi zài chú fáng zuò fàn
en: Who is cooking in the kitchen?
why: 谁 stands in the subject slot, exactly where the answer "Mom" would go. 哪 and 几 need a measure word, and 什么 asks about things, not people.

py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ jiàn chèn shān
en: Which shirt do you want to buy?
why: Choosing among shirts that are in front of you takes 哪 plus a measure word: 哪件. 什么 cannot stand directly before 件, and 谁 and 哪儿 ask about people and places.

zh: 你们什么时候去超市买东西？
py: nǐ men shén me shí hou qù chāo shì mǎi dōng xī
en: When are you going to the supermarket to buy things?
why: "When" is 什么时候, and like any time word it sits before the verb. 什么 asks "what", 哪儿 asks "where" and 几 asks "how many".

zh: 小王的爸爸在哪儿上班？
py: xiǎo wáng de bà ba zài nǎ r shàng bān
en: Where does Xiao Wang's dad work?
why: The answer would be a place after 在, so the slot holds 哪儿. 哪个 would need a noun after it (哪个公司), and 谁 and 什么 do not stand for places.

q: 桌子上有两个杯子，你要___个？
zh: 桌子上有两个杯子，你要哪个？
py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu liǎng gè bēi zi nǐ yào nǎ ge
en: There are two cups on the table. Which one do you want?
why: Picking one of two cups you can both see is 哪 plus a measure word. 什么个 is not possible; 什么 would go before a noun, as in 什么杯子.

zh: 你想给奶奶买什么礼物？
py: nǐ xiǎng gěi nǎi nai mǎi shén me lǐ wù
en: What present do you want to buy for Grandma?
why: An open "what kind of" question takes 什么 straight before the noun. 哪 and 几 need a measure word, so 哪礼物 and 几礼物 are not grammatical.

q: 你昨天在商场门口等的那位客人是___？
zh: 你昨天在商场门口等的那位客人是谁？
py: nǐ zuó tiān zài shāng chǎng mén kǒu děng de nà wèi kè ren shì shéi
en: Who was the customer you waited for at the mall entrance yesterday?
why: Asking who someone is puts 谁 where the name would go. 什么 would ask what a thing is, and 哪 and 几 need a measure word after them.

py: nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng
en: What time do you get up every day?
why: Clock hours are asked with the fixed form 几点. 多少点 is not used for the time, and 怎么点 and 什么点 do not mean "what time".

py: zhè ge shǒu jī duō shǎo qián
en: How much is this mobile phone?
why: A price is always asked with 多少钱. 几钱 fails because 几 needs a measure word and expects a small number, and 什么钱 would mean "what money".

py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi duō shǎo píng guǒ
en: How many apples do you want to buy?
why: With no measure word between the question word and 苹果, 多少 is the one that can stand directly before the noun. 几苹果 and 哪苹果 lack a measure word, and 什么苹果 would mean "what kind of apples".

zh: 妈妈的手机号码是多少？
py: mā ma de shǒu jī hào mǎ shì duō shǎo
en: What is Mom's phone number?
why: A phone number is a long string of digits, not a small count, so it is asked with 多少. 几 expects a small number with a measure word, so 是几 cannot ask for a number like this.

zh: 今天星期几？商店开门吗？
py: jīn tiān xīng qī jǐ shāng diàn kāi mén ma
en: What day of the week is it today? Is the shop open?
why: Days of the week are asked with the fixed phrase 星期几. 多少 is never used here, and 星期哪 and 星期什么 are not said.

py: zhè ge xǐ yī jī zěn me yòng
en: How do you use this washing machine?
why: Asking how to do something is 怎么 directly before the verb 用. 怎么样 asks what something is like and cannot precede a verb, and 为什么 asks for a reason.

q: 你觉得这家商店的衣服___？
zh: 你觉得这家商店的衣服怎么样？
py: nǐ jué de zhè jiā shāng diàn de yī fu zěn me yàng
en: What do you think of the clothes in this shop?
why: "What is it like?" ends the sentence with the predicate 怎么样. 怎么 needs a verb after it, so 衣服怎么 is unfinished, and 为什么 asks for a reason, not an opinion.

q: 已经十二点了，你___还不睡觉？
zh: 已经十二点了，你怎么还不睡觉？
py: yǐ jīng shí èr diǎn le nǐ zěn me hái bù shuì jiào
en: It is already twelve. How come you still have not gone to bed?
why: 怎么 before 还不 means "how come" and shows surprise that things are not as expected. 怎么样 is a predicate and cannot come before 还不, and 哪 and 几 do not fit here.

q: 妈妈___不让我买这个玩具？
zh: 妈妈为什么不让我买这个玩具？
py: mā ma wèi shén me bù ràng wǒ mǎi zhè ge wán jù
en: Why won't Mom let me buy this toy?
why: A plain request for a reason is 为什么, placed before 不. 怎么样 asks what something is like, and 什么 and 哪 cannot stand before 不让.

zh: 在这家店，你可以怎么付钱？
py: zài zhè jiā diàn nǐ kě yǐ zěn me fù qián
en: In this shop, in what ways can you pay?
why: "In what way" before a verb is 怎么. 怎么样 and 什么样 describe what something is like and cannot go before 付钱, and 为什么 would ask why.

q: 这台洗衣机的声音这么大，你___还说它很安静？
zh: 这台洗衣机的声音这么大，你怎么还说它很安静？
py: zhè tái xǐ yī jī de shēng yīn zhè me dà nǐ zěn me hái shuō tā hěn ān jìng
en: This washing machine is so loud. How come you still say it is quiet?
why: 怎么 before 还说 means "how come" and shows surprise at a contradiction. 怎么样 is a predicate, 什么 does not fit before a verb phrase here, and 哪里 would ask about a place.

py: nǐ dì di jīn nián duō dà le
en: How old is your younger brother this year?
why: Age is asked with 多 plus the "big" adjective: 多大. 几大, 多少大 and 怎么大 are not used to ask for an age.

py: cóng nǐ jiā dào chāo shì yǒu duō yuǎn
en: How far is it from your home to the supermarket?
why: "How far" is 多 plus the neutral adjective 远: 多远. 怎么 asks how to do something, 多少 asks for an amount, and 多近 is not the neutral question about distance.

py: nǐ men jiā de shā fā yǒu duō cháng
en: How long is your family's sofa?
why: Length is asked with 有多长: 多 goes directly before the adjective 长. 几, 多少 and 怎么 cannot be put in front of an adjective.

q: 你每天在商店工作___时间？
zh: 你每天在商店工作多长时间？
py: nǐ měi tiān zài shāng diàn gōng zuò duō cháng shí jiān
en: How long do you work in the shop every day?
why: Duration is asked with 多长时间. The adjective 长 follows 多 directly; 多少长, 怎么长 and 几长 are not possible.

q: 你们搬进这个新家___了，习惯了吗？
zh: 你们搬进这个新家多久了，习惯了吗？
py: nǐ men bān jìn zhè ge xīn jiā duō jiǔ le xí guàn le ma
en: How long have you been in this new home? Have you got used to it?
why: 多久 is the fixed "how long" for a stretch of time, the same as 多长时间. 多少久, 几久 and 怎么久 are not words.

zh: 我们周末一起去逛街，好吗？
py: wǒ men zhōu mò yì qǐ qù guàng jiē hǎo ma
en: Let's go shopping together at the weekend, shall we?
why: A suggestion that asks the listener to agree takes 好吗. 对吗 and 是吗 check whether a fact is true, and 呢 cannot follow a plain statement like this.

zh: 你是小李的姐姐，对不对？
py: nǐ shì xiǎo lǐ de jiě jie duì bú duì
en: You are Xiao Li's older sister, right?
why: Checking a fact you believe is true takes 对不对. 好不好 and 行吗 ask someone to agree to a plan, which does not fit a statement of identity.

py: mā ma wǒ de shū bāo ne
en: Mom, where is my schoolbag?
why: After a bare noun, 呢 asks "where is it?". 吗 would ask a yes/no question about the schoolbag itself, and 的 and 了 do not form a question.

q: 这些菜是你今天早上买的，___？
zh: 这些菜是你今天早上买的，对吗？
py: zhè xiē cài shì nǐ jīn tiān zǎo shàng mǎi de duì ma
en: You bought these vegetables this morning, right?
why: The speaker is checking a fact, so the tag is 对吗. 好吗 and 行吗 ask for approval of a suggestion, and a statement about the past is not a suggestion.

q: 我今天去超市买了菜，还给奶奶买了药，你___？
zh: 我今天去超市买了菜，还给奶奶买了药，你呢？
py: wǒ jīn tiān qù chāo shì mǎi le cài hái gěi nǎi nai mǎi le yào nǐ ne
en: Today I went to the supermarket for vegetables, and I also bought medicine for Grandma. What about you?
why: After a statement about oneself, a noun or pronoun plus 呢 asks "and what about you?". 吗 would turn it into a yes/no question about 你 alone, and 的 and 了 cannot close it.

py: wǒ shén me dōu bù xiǎng mǎi
en: I do not want to buy anything.
why: 什么 plus 都 plus a negative verb means "nothing at all". The question word comes before 都; 吗, 呢 and 吧 would not give "anything".

q: 桌子上___也没有，连一支笔都没有。
zh: 桌子上什么也没有，连一支笔都没有。
py: zhuō zi shàng shén me yě méi yǒu lián yī zhī bǐ dōu méi yǒu
en: There is nothing on the table, not even a pen.
why: 什么 plus 也 plus 没有 means "nothing". 谁 would mean "nobody" and 哪儿 "nowhere", which do not fit objects on a table.

q: 这个牌子的衣服___都能买到。
zh: 这个牌子的衣服哪儿都能买到。
py: zhè ge pái zi de yī fu nǎ r dōu néng mǎi dào
en: You can buy this brand's clothes anywhere.
why: 哪儿 plus 都 means "anywhere", and it comes before 都 and the verb. 谁 would mean "anybody", which is not what is meant here.

q: 这件衣服___什么问题，就是有点儿贵。
zh: 这件衣服没有什么问题，就是有点儿贵。
py: zhè jiàn yī fu méi yǒu shén me wèn tí jiù shì yǒu diǎn r guì
en: There is nothing much wrong with this piece of clothing, it is just a bit expensive.
why: 没有什么 + noun means "not any / nothing in particular", and the noun stays after the verb. 不 cannot negate 有, and 别 is a command.

q: 他们家的亲戚我___也不认识，所以不想去参加婚礼。
zh: 他们家的亲戚我谁也不认识，所以不想去参加婚礼。
py: tā men jiā de qīn qī wǒ shéi yě bù rèn shi suǒ yǐ bù xiǎng qù cān jiā hūn lǐ
en: I do not know anyone among their relatives, so I do not want to go to the wedding.
why: "Nobody" is 谁 + 也 + 不 with 谁 before 也. 什么 would say "nothing", and 哪儿 and 几 do not stand for people.

q: 你___说今天给我买新书包吗？
zh: 你不是说今天给我买新书包吗？
py: nǐ bú shì shuō jīn tiān gěi wǒ mǎi xīn shū bāo ma
en: Didn't you say you would buy me a new schoolbag today?
why: Reminding someone of what they said takes 不是 after the subject and 吗 at the end. 不会 and 别 do not give the "didn't you say" meaning, and 是不是 clashes with 吗.

zh: 你姐姐不是已经结婚了吗？
py: nǐ jiě jie bú shì yǐ jīng jié hūn le ma
en: Hasn't your sister already got married?
why: 不是 … 吗 reminds the listener of something the speaker believes is already true. 没有 cannot be put before 已经 here, and 是不是 would clash with 吗.

q: 爸爸不是说这个周末带我们去商场___？
zh: 爸爸不是说这个周末带我们去商场吗？
py: bà ba bú shì shuō zhè ge zhōu mò dài wǒ men qù shāng chǎng ma
en: Didn't Dad say he would take us to the mall this weekend?
why: The pattern 不是 … 吗 must be closed by 吗; without it the sentence is just a negative statement. 的, 了 and 哪 cannot end this question.

zh: 你爸爸明天去不去超市？
py: nǐ bà ba míng tiān qù bù qù chāo shì
en: Is your dad going to the supermarket tomorrow?
why: The A-not-A form 去不去 sits where the verb goes, before the object 超市. 明天 may come before or after the subject but cannot follow the verb phrase, and no 吗 is added.

zh: 你妈妈会不会用微波炉？
py: nǐ mā ma huì bú huì yòng wēi bō lú
en: Can your mom use a microwave?
why: With a modal, the modal is doubled: 会不会 comes before the verb phrase 用微波炉. No 吗 is added, because the doubled form already asks the question.

zh: 你是不是也想买新沙发？
py: nǐ shì bú shì yě xiǎng mǎi xīn shā fā
en: Do you want to buy a new sofa too?
why: 是不是 stands before the predicate to check a guess, and 也 follows it directly before 想买. The question needs no 吗.

py: nǐ xiǎng hē chá hái shì hē kā fēi
en: Do you want to drink tea or coffee?
why: 还是 sits between the two parallel options and no 吗 is added. 或者 would only list options in a statement.

zh: 妈妈想买红色的还是蓝色的？
py: mā ma xiǎng mǎi hóng sè de hái shì lán sè de
en: Does Mom want to buy the red one or the blue one?
why: The two options are joined by 还是, which is itself the question marker, so nothing like 吗 closes the sentence.

py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù yín háng
en: When are you going to the bank?
why: 什么时候 behaves like any time word: it goes before the verb, either after or before the subject, and never at the end of the sentence as "when" does in English.

py: shéi gěi nǐ mǎi le zhè běn shū
en: Who bought you this book?
why: 谁 stays in the subject slot, where the answer "Dad" would go. The sentence keeps statement order and adds no 吗.

py: nǐ jiě jie zài nǎ r mǎi yī fu
en: Where does your older sister buy clothes?
why: 在哪儿 sits where 在商场 would sit, before the verb phrase. It does not move to the front of the sentence as in English.

py: zhè tiáo kù zi duō shǎo qián
en: How much are these trousers?
why: 多少钱 is the fixed way to ask a price and goes at the end, where the price would be. 几钱 is not possible.

py: nǐ yí gè yuè huā duō shǎo qián
en: How much money do you spend a month?
why: 多少钱 fills the object slot after 花. 一个月 is a time frame that may come before or after 你 but not after 花.

py: zhè ge shǒu jī zěn me yòng
en: How do you use this phone?
why: 怎么 comes right before the verb it asks about: 怎么用. 怎么样 would be a predicate and cannot precede 用.

py: nǐ jué de zhè jiā diàn zěn me yàng
en: What do you think of this shop?
why: 怎么样 is the predicate at the end, asking what the shop is like. 怎么 alone could not end the sentence.

zh: 你为什么不买那件外套？
py: nǐ wèi shén me bù mǎi nà jiàn wài tào
en: Why don't you buy that coat?
why: 为什么 comes before 不买, as a reason word sits before the verb phrase. It can precede or follow 你 but never stands at the end.

py: nǐ sūn zi duō dà le
en: How old is your grandson?
why: 多 plus the "big" adjective 大 asks the age, and 了 closes it. Neither 很 nor 吗 is added.

py: cóng nǐ jiā dào shāng chǎng yǒu duō yuǎn
en: How far is it from your home to the mall?
why: The start and goal come first, then 有多远. 有 may be dropped, but it cannot follow 多远.

zh: 你在这家店工作了多长时间？
py: nǐ zài zhè jiā diàn gōng zuò le duō cháng shí jiān
en: How long have you worked in this shop?
why: 多长时间 asks the duration and closes the verb phrase. The place phrase 在这家店 stays before the verb and may come before or after 你.

py: wǒ men yì qǐ qù chāo shì hǎo ma
en: Let's go to the supermarket together, okay?
why: The statement comes first and the tag 好吗 closes it, with 一起 before the verb phrase. 好吗 asks for agreement to a suggestion.

zh: 你是奶奶的邻居，对不对？
py: nǐ shì nǎi nai de lín jū duì bú duì
en: You are Grandma's neighbour, right?
why: To check a fact you believe is true, finish the statement and add 对不对. The tag always stands at the end.

py: wǒ jīn tiān zài jiā nǐ ne
en: I am at home today, and you?
why: 你呢 follows a statement and asks about the other person. 今天 may come before or after 我 but 在家 stays after the subject.

py: nǐ zài zhǎo shén me ne
en: What are you looking for?
why: 呢 can close a question that already has a question word. 什么 stays after 在找, where the answer would go.

py: wǒ shén me dōu bù xiǎng mǎi
en: I do not want to buy anything.
why: The question word 什么 comes before 都 and the negative verb, so it means "anything / nothing" and is not a question.

zh: 这家店的价格谁都知道。
py: zhè jiā diàn de jià gé shéi dōu zhī dào
en: Everybody knows this shop's prices.
why: 谁 before 都 means "everyone". The object 这家店的价格 is placed first as the topic, so 谁 can stand right in front of 都.

py: jīn tiān wǒ nǎ r yě bù xiǎng qù
en: I do not want to go anywhere today.
why: 哪儿 + 也 + a negative verb means "nowhere". The question word stands before 也, not after the verb.

py: tā zài shāng chǎng shén me yě méi mǎi
en: He did not buy anything at the mall.
why: 什么 + 也 + 没 means "nothing". The place phrase 在商场 stays before the verb and may come before or after 他.

zh: 你不是说过给我买新手机吗？
py: nǐ bú shì shuō guò gěi wǒ mǎi xīn shǒu jī ma
en: Didn't you say you would buy me a new phone?
why: 不是 follows the subject and 吗 closes the sentence; the middle part states what the speaker believes was promised.

src_py: nǐ nǎi nai xǐ huan zhè jiàn máo yī
task: Turn it into an A-not-A question.
zh: 你奶奶喜不喜欢这件毛衣？
py: nǐ nǎi nai xǐ bù xǐ huan zhè jiàn máo yī
en: Does your grandma like this sweater?
why: The first syllable of 喜欢 is doubled with 不: 喜不喜欢. 吗 is not added, since the A-not-A form is already the question.

task: Ask it with 想不想 (an A-not-A question).
py: tā xiǎng bù xiǎng qù shāng chǎng
en: Does she want to go to the mall?
why: With a modal verb the modal is doubled: 想不想, and the verb phrase 去商场 follows unchanged.

task: Ask "cash or card?" with 还是.
py: nǐ xiàn jīn fù kuǎn hái shì shuā kǎ
en: Will you pay in cash or by card?
why: The two options sit on either side of 还是 and the statement order is kept. 吗 and 或者 are both wrong in a choice question.

src_py: mā ma zài chāo shì mǎi le yú
task: Ask where Mom bought the fish.
py: mā ma zài nǎ r mǎi le yú
en: Where did Mom buy the fish?
why: 哪儿 replaces 超市 in the same slot, so 在哪儿 stays before the verb. Nothing moves and no 吗 is added.

src_py: zhè ge bēi zi shí wǔ kuài
py: zhè ge bēi zi duō shǎo qián
en: How much is this cup?
why: Price is asked with 多少钱, put in the slot of the amount. 几 cannot be used because it needs a measure word.

src_py: wǒ ér zi wǔ suì le
task: Ask how old your son is.
py: nǐ ér zi duō dà le
en: How old is your son?
why: Age is asked with 多大, with the 了 of the statement kept. 几岁 is for a small child, while 多大 is the general form.

py: nǐ zuó tiān zěn me méi lái
en: How come you didn't come yesterday?
why: 怎么 stands right before 没来 and expresses surprise that it did not happen. The time word 昨天 stays before it.

src_py: wǒ men zhōu mò qù shāng chǎng
task: Add a tag asking if that is okay.
py: wǒ men zhōu mò qù shāng chǎng hǎo ma
en: Let's go to the mall at the weekend, okay?
why: A suggestion is turned into a request for agreement by adding 好吗 at the end. The statement itself does not change.

task: Say "I bought nothing at all" with 什么.
py: wǒ shén me yě méi mǎi
en: I did not buy anything.
why: 什么 replaces 东西 and moves in front of 也 and the negative verb, which gives "nothing at all". It is not a question.

src: 爸爸已经把钱给奶奶了。
src_py: bà ba yǐ jīng bǎ qián gěi nǎi nai le
task: Say "Hasn't Dad already...?" with 不是 ... 吗.
zh: 爸爸不是已经把钱给奶奶了吗？
py: bà ba bú shì yǐ jīng bǎ qián gěi nǎi nai le ma
en: Hasn't Dad already given the money to Grandma?
why: 不是 goes after the subject and 吗 closes the sentence. What lies between keeps its own 了, since it is what the speaker believes is true.

s_py: nǐ yǒu bù yǒu líng qián
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu líng qián
en: Do you have any small change?
why: 有 is negated only with 没, so its A-not-A form is 有没有. 有不有 does not exist.

s: 你妹妹喜不喜欢这件裙子吗？
s_py: nǐ mèi mei xǐ bù xǐ huan zhè jiàn qún zi ma
zh: 你妹妹喜不喜欢这件裙子？
py: nǐ mèi mei xǐ bù xǐ huan zhè jiàn qún zi
en: Does your younger sister like this skirt?
why: 喜不喜欢 already asks the question, so adding 吗 stacks two question markers. Use one or the other, never both.

s: 你想买红的还是蓝的吗？
s_py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi hóng de hái shì lán de ma
py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi hóng de hái shì lán de
en: Do you want to buy the red one or the blue one?
why: 还是 already makes the choice question, so 吗 is a second question marker and must go.

s_py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ shū
py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ běn shū
en: Which book do you want to buy?
why: 哪 always needs a measure word before the noun, so 哪本书 is right. 哪书 is not possible.

s_py: nǐ yī gòng huā le jǐ qián
py: nǐ yī gòng huā le duō shǎo qián
en: How much did you spend in total?
why: Money is asked with 多少钱. 几 needs a measure word and expects a small number, so 几钱 does not exist.

s_py: zhè jiā diàn de dōng xī zěn me
py: zhè jiā diàn de dōng xī zěn me yàng
en: What are the things in this shop like?
why: "What is it like?" needs 怎么样 as the predicate. 怎么 alone needs a verb after it and cannot end the sentence.

s: 我想知道这个手机怎么样用。
s_py: wǒ xiǎng zhī dào zhè ge shǒu jī zěn me yàng yòng
zh: 我想知道这个手机怎么用。
py: wǒ xiǎng zhī dào zhè ge shǒu jī zěn me yòng
en: I want to know how to use this phone.
why: "How to do something" is 怎么 plus the verb. 怎么样 describes what something is like and cannot stand before 用.

s_py: nǐ men jiā lí xué xiào duō shǎo yuǎn
py: nǐ men jiā lí xué xiào duō yuǎn
en: How far is your home from the school?
why: "How far" is 多 plus 远. 多少 asks for an amount and cannot be put in front of an adjective.

s_py: wǒ bù xiǎng mǎi shén me dōu
py: wǒ shén me dōu bù xiǎng mǎi
en: I do not want to buy anything.
why: The question word must stand before 都, so the object 什么 moves in front of the verb. Left after 买, the 都 has nothing to attach to.

s_py: nǐ shì wǒ de lín jū ne
py: nǐ shì wǒ de lín jū ma
en: Are you my neighbour?
why: 呢 cannot turn a plain statement into a yes/no question; that takes 吗. 呢 fits questions that already have a question word, and bare nouns.

s: 你是不是不想吃妈妈做的菜？
s_py: nǐ shì bú shì bù xiǎng chī mā ma zuò de cài
zh: 你是不是不想吃妈妈做的菜？
py: nǐ shì bú shì bù xiǎng chī mā ma zuò de cài
en: Is it that you do not want to eat the dish Mom made?
why: 是不是 can stand before a predicate that already contains 不, to check a guess. Adding 吗 or doubling 想 would clash with that 不.

s_py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng kàn diàn shì
py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng kàn diàn shì
en: Do you want to watch TV?
why: With a modal verb the modal is doubled: 想不想, followed by the plain verb 看. No 吗 is needed.

s: 我不知道妈妈今天买鱼还是买肉。
s_py: wǒ bù zhī dào mā ma jīn tiān mǎi yú hái shì mǎi ròu
zh: 我不知道妈妈今天买鱼还是买肉。
py: wǒ bù zhī dào mā ma jīn tiān mǎi yú hái shì mǎi ròu
en: I do not know whether Mom is buying fish or meat today.
why: 还是 is also used inside a statement when the speaker does not know which of two things is true. 或者 would wrongly present both as simply possible.

s_py: nǐ xiǎng chī diǎn r shén me ma
py: nǐ xiǎng chī diǎn r shén me ma
en: Would you like something to eat?
why: Here 什么 means "something", not "what", so the sentence is a yes/no question and needs 吗. It is correct even though a real "what" question never takes 吗.

s: 你们家一个月花多少钱？
s_py: nǐ men jiā yí gè yuè huā duō shǎo qián
zh: 你们家一个月花多少钱？
py: nǐ men jiā yí gè yuè huā duō shǎo qián
en: How much does your family spend a month?
why: Spending is an open amount, so 多少 is right, and it needs no measure word before 钱. 几 would expect a very small number.

s_py: nǐ zěn me hái méi qǐ chuáng
py: nǐ zěn me hái méi qǐ chuáng
en: How come you still have not got up?
why: 怎么 before 还没 means "how come" and shows surprise. It is correct even though 怎么 usually asks "how to".

s: 你爷爷今年多大年纪了？
s_py: nǐ yé ye jīn nián duō dà nián jì le
zh: 你爷爷今年多大年纪了？
py: nǐ yé ye jīn nián duō dà nián jì le
en: How old is your grandfather this year?
why: 多大年纪 is the polite way to ask an older person's age; the pattern 多 + 大 is still used, with no 很 and no 怎么.

s_py: nǐ míng tiān bù zài jiā shì bú shì
py: nǐ míng tiān bù zài jiā shì bú shì
en: You will not be at home tomorrow, will you?
why: A negative statement still takes the same tag 是不是. Chinese does not flip the tag as English does.

s: 周末我哪儿也不想去，只想在家休息。
s_py: zhōu mò wǒ nǎ r yě bù xiǎng qù zhǐ xiǎng zài jiā xiū xī
zh: 周末我哪儿也不想去，只想在家休息。
py: zhōu mò wǒ nǎ r yě bù xiǎng qù zhǐ xiǎng zài jiā xiū xī
en: At the weekend I do not want to go anywhere, I just want to rest at home.
why: 哪儿 + 也 + 不 means "nowhere" and stands before the verb. It is not a question about where.

s_py: nǐ bú shì bù ài chī yú ma
py: nǐ bú shì bù ài chī yú ma
en: I thought you did not like fish?
why: 不是 … 吗 reminds the listener of what the speaker believed, and the part between keeps its own 不. The two negatives do not cancel out.
